description: A path group (`./src/deep/`, on its files' total), a glob group (`./src/**/*.ts`, checked file by file, one line per file) and `global` (which takes the files no other group named, so every file here) under Jest 30.5.2 (T8.11): `src/deep/total.ts` is in the path group and the glob group both.
